expectations: Does not route to security-and-hardening as the skill to run, since the request is to build something and that skill produces advice rather than code

Routes to a workflow that produces code, naming it, rather than leaving the build implicit
Says what security-and-hardening would produce if run at this request, rather than rejecting it only as premature or out of scope
In response.md specifically, the reason given for the routing is the kind of artifact each candidate produces, not which description best matches the words of the request
